items.title: define baseline manifest schema and storage shape
items.goal: Choose the narrowest machine-readable schema/location for baseline v1 so later runner wiring has a fixed source of truth.
items.promptText:
Inspect the current P5 codepath and docs for `materialize curated P5 baseline into machine-readable manifest` first.
Then make the smallest concrete change to complete `define baseline manifest schema and storage shape` without broadening scope.
Wave goal: Turn the approved engineering baseline v1 decisions into one manifest-backed runner source of truth.
Task goal: Choose the narrowest machine-readable schema/location for baseline v1 so later runner wiring has a fixed source of truth.
Relevant scope: apps/api/scripts, storage/evals or docs baseline manifest, docs/current-dev-setup.md, docs/current-progress.md
Acceptance:
- One manifest shape is defined for question set, layered annotations, and baseline source declaration.
- Storage location is explicit and does not introduce a new platform layer.
Do not:
- No eval runner contract rewrite
- No web report-center redesign
Run exactly one focused validation command: `git diff --check -- docs/current-dev-setup.md docs/current-progress.md`.
Report the exact changed files and exact validation result.

checklist: One manifest shape is defined for question set, layered annotations, and baseline source declaration.
Storage location is explicit and does not introduce a new platform layer.

suspendWhen: Manifest location decision still conflicts with current runner/report boundaries

items.title: materialize approved baseline v1 into manifest source
items.goal: Create the actual machine-readable manifest/file that stores the approved baseline v1 decisions.
items.promptText:
Inspect the current P5 codepath and docs for `materialize curated P5 baseline into machine-readable manifest` first.

Wave goal: Turn the approved engineering baseline v1 decisions into one manifest-backed runner source of truth.
Task goal: Create the actual machine-readable manifest/file that stores the approved baseline v1 decisions.
Relevant scope: apps/api/scripts, storage/evals or docs baseline manifest, docs/current-dev-setup.md, docs/current-progress.md
Assume these earlier queue items are completed first: p5-manifest-schema-and-storage-shape.
Acceptance:
- Manifest contains baseline questions, default-layer annotations, critical-question evidence rules, and baseline source declaration.
- Manifest is parseable and can be referenced from runner/docs.
Do not:
- No eval runner contract rewrite
- No web report-center redesign
Run exactly one focused validation command: `node --input-type=module -e "import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; console.log(readFileSync(process.argv[1], 'utf8').length > 0 ? 'ok' : 'empty');" apps/api/scripts/p5-baseline-manifest.v1.json`.
Report the exact changed files and exact validation result.

checklist: Manifest contains baseline questions, default-layer annotations, critical-question evidence rules, and baseline source declaration.
Manifest is parseable and can be referenced from runner/docs.

suspendWhen: Approved baseline v1 questions/annotations/source declaration are not ready
